title: 11. Security Invariants
raw:
## 11. Security Invariants

Quint/TLA+ models under `../formal-specs/` describe versions of the invariants below.
The invariants are normative. A model-checking result applies to the stated model, assumptions, explored
bounds, and tool run; a model file alone is not a proof of every implementation execution. The attribution
index and Appendix H separate those artifacts from runtime enforcement and open conformance obligations.

### 11.1 Enforced invariants

| Invariant | Rule (normative) | Enforcement |
|-----------|------------------|-------------|
| INV-02 / session cap | session spending **MUST** be ≤ the session cap | `agent_transfer` checks `remaining_session_cap()` (`SessionCapExceeded`) |
| `fail_task` authority | only an authorized reporter, rate-limited, **MUST** fail a task | none: the per-task path and its `fail_task` call were removed (Appendix H.5), so this rule binds no current call |
| INV-S01 / session nonce | a session nonce **MUST** be monotonic (anti-replay) | `SessionInfo.nonce` validated + incremented per use (`InvalidSessionNonce`) |
| INV-M06 / payout atomicity | a settlement payout **MUST** be all-or-nothing: the miner and validator legs, the agent refund and the `φ·(E−P)` transfer to `FLOPFoundationAccount` (R12.1d) either all land or none does | compute-channel `payout_settlement`: a failed miner transfer, agent refund or penalty leg reverts the settling extrinsic, so no leg lands without the others (penalty-leg sink: Appendix H.5) |
| Supply | emission cap + halving monotonicity **MUST** hold | `tokenomics-supply.qnt` |
| HTLC | local conservation + conditional completion + timelock symmetry (§10) | `htlc-atomic-swap.qnt` |
| Channel | conservation + no-double-settle **MUST** hold | `channel/channel-settlement.qnt` |
| DA | retrievability + serve-or-slash (§5.3) | `da/da-retrievability.qnt` |

### 11.2 Session `G_n` settlement gate

- **R11.2.** Channel `settle` / `force_settle` **MUST** call `GnSink::validate_session_gn` before payout
  or credit: a non-zero aggregate `G_n` **MUST** fit the credit domain, the miner efficiency ceiling, the
  finalized calibration cap, the §6.1 capacity bond, and the reject-only throughput tripwire (§4.1).
- **R11.2a.** This is a **plausibility bound, not execution validation.** `settle` **MUST** verify each
  submitted `VerifiedTurn` signature and Merkle path against one `final_root`, reject duplicate or
  out-of-range turn indices, checked-sum the submitted `g_n` values, and require that sum to equal
  `aggregate_gn` (`verified_work_from_turns`; §12.1). This authenticates the submitted leaf values and
  their arithmetic. It does not prove that the claimed execution occurred or that the submitted turns
  exhaust an independently committed transcript (E.43/E.44).
- **R11.2b.** Current-profile channel payout **MUST NOT** issue public work credit, increase reward
  accumulators or performance-vesting work, refresh committee recency, or update calibration from a
  receipt. This applies to cooperative, certificate, unilateral, forward, and unrecoverable-DA payout.
  Challenge expiry alone **MUST NOT** make a receipt eligible for public work credit. (Private,
  payment-denominated Miner unlock credit and Agent spend credit on Era-0 airdrop grants under §8.2 R8.7
  are not public work credit, block-reward accumulation, or `work-vesting` (`R_p²`), and accrue after
  finality plus [`channel_dispute_window_blocks`](#param-channel_dispute_window_blocks) as governed by
  R8.7.) Future independently audited public work credit
  and recovery of historical credit require the separate evidence and protocol disposition in E.44.

### 11.3 Validator slashing table

`pallet_validators` is the single authority for validator penalties.

| Offence | Penalty | Effect | Re-entry |
|---------|---------|--------|----------|
| Collusion (signing a fake `G_n` proof) | [`slash_fraud_percent`](#param-slash_fraud_percent) = 100% slash (to Foundation) | eject + blacklist | none |
| Equivocation (conflicting blocks) | correlated (Eth2-style): lone [`slash_equivocation_lone_percent`](#param-slash_equivocation_lone_percent) = 50% slash (other 50% returned after 180 d), ≥⅓ correlated → 100% slash (to Foundation) | lone: eject (re-stakeable); cartel: eject + blacklist | lone: re-stake after the 180 d return + unlock cooldown; cartel: none |
| Evidence forgery | 100% slash (to Foundation) | eject + blacklist | none |
| TEE-attestation failure *(HARD-tier attestations only)* | 100% slash (to Foundation) | eject + blacklist | none |
| Liveness — downtime > 300 blocks | [`slash_liveness_percent`](#param-slash_liveness_percent) = 1% | jailed | `un_jail` after ≥ 1 h |
| Extended downtime > 24 h | [`validator_extended_downtime_slash_percent`](#param-validator_extended_downtime_slash_percent) = 5% | kicked | `rejoin` with full stake top-up |

Collusion/forgery/TEE stay flat 100% (evidence-backed fraud). Equivocation is the only correlated,
recoverable class (a lone double-sign is most often an honest failover bug). All slashed collateral routes
100% to `FLOPFoundationAccount` with zero burn (§9.3 R9.10). Operator stake is self-stake only (third-party
delegated staking is prohibited); where legacy or testnet sponsored backing (E.32) is present, the loss
order charges operator self-stake first and sponsors thereafter at the fault rate (legacy delegator
waterfall entries are deprecated).

### Rationale & sources *(non-normative)*

`D-0530` (operator self-stake only; delegation waterfall deprecated). The P0 agent-economics sweep (INV-02, `fail_task`, session nonce, payout
atomicity) closed the four flagged-not-enforced invariants. Grounding:
`formal-specs-agent-economics.md`,

(`StakingSlashing`, `CoCVoC`), `FlopSpecs/Sessions.lean`,
`channel/session-gn-integrity.qnt`. Status:
